eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Setting aside the verdict and dismissal of the information under RCW 9.95.240(1), Defendant having been discharged from probation before the period ended and the application being made before the maximum period of punishment for the offence expires
additionalFacts: Defendant was discharged from probation before the period of probation ended, which RCW 9.95.240(1) treats as an alternative to fulfilling the conditions for the entire period.

Defendant understands that relief under RCW 9.95.240(1) is discretionary, and that the proviso to that subsection preserves the conviction for pleading and proof in any subsequent prosecution for any other offence, with the same effect as if probation had not been granted.
Defendant asks the Court to permit the verdict to be set aside and to dismiss the information, so that Defendant is released from all penalties and disabilities resulting from the offence.
Defendant states the circumstances relied on in the accompanying statement; that statement is completed by Defendant and is not supplied by any other person.
